execution: stock eager; no added operator acceleration
policy: Fixed frame, no churn, reverse alignment or guidance; unit step scale; unchanged sigma endpoints
reference: Same-condition Heun512 (1023 NFE), with Heun256 reference sensitivity
decision: Keep standard midpoint as default; first-order low-noise tail is a promising 16-NFE structure-stage candidate. Ligand-only damping is a tradeoff, not an accepted improvement.
limitations: One unlabeled complex, two seeds; no physical validity or enrichment conclusion.
Coordinate RMS is per coordinate, not per-atom Euclidean RMSD.
Each study holds conditioning and initial RNG fixed; affinity conditions differ across full structure variants and those studies must not be pooled as identical-condition replicates.
Heun256/512 disagreement reaches 0.0371 A coordinate RMS in one affinity condition; numerical reference is approximate.
Timing covers sampling only; study CLI includes reference trajectories and diagnostic overhead.
History damping is a heuristic that generally sacrifices second-order accuracy; finite-sigma tail lowering is an experimental hybrid, not a guaranteed higher-order method.
